description: This line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) of four different SepLLM configurations as a function of computational cost measured in TFLOPs. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs", spans from 1e7 to 9e8 on a logarithmic scale, with tick marks appearing at intervals of one order of magnitude. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)", ranges from 94% to 100% with tick marks at 1% intervals. The plot contains four distinct lines: the purple line with triangle markers represents "SepLLM (n=64)", the orange line with circular markers represents "SepLLM (n=128)", the green line with diamond markers represents "SepLLM (n=64, H)", and the red line with circular markers represents "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)". The "SepLLM (n=64)" line remains nearly constant at 100% across the entire TFLOPs range. The "SepLLM (n=128)" line starts at approximately 98.5% and rises to about 99.8% before slightly declining. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" line begins at approximately 97.5% and increases to nearly 100%, remaining relatively stable thereafter. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" line starts at 94% and rises to about 99.1% before gradually declining to approximately 98.8%.
